info.title: Darkhorse Identity Protocol API
info.summary: The supported third-party OpenID Connect and OAuth token surface.
info.description: This specification covers the supported confidential-client protocol endpoints. Replace the example server with the issuer returned by discovery. The route-classification document inventories private first-party browser APIs, operational routes, public presentation routes, and static files that are not client integration APIs. Access and refresh tokens are opaque; ID tokens are signed JWTs. Examples use synthetic values and are for request shape only; never use them as credentials. This file contains no deployment-specific URLs, client data, or credentials.

servers.description: Documentation placeholder. Use the exact HTTPS issuer value from the deployment's discovery document.

get.summary: Read the active issuer's OpenID Provider metadata
get.description: The document is available only when the provider has an active signing key. Values are derived from the configured canonical HTTPS issuer. A deployment without an active key returns 503.

es.summary: Consultar los metadatos OpenID Provider del emisor activo
es.description: El documento solo está disponible cuando el proveedor tiene una clave de firma activa. Los valores provienen del emisor HTTPS canónico configurado. Si no hay una clave activa, el despliegue responde con 503.

200.description: Supported OIDC and token endpoint metadata.

get.summary: Read the public JSON Web Key Set
get.description: Returns public RSA signing keys only. The implementation uses RS256 and publishes the key ID, modulus, exponent, use, and algorithm. Private signing material is never returned. Responses currently use no-store caching.

es.summary: Consultar el conjunto público de claves web JSON
es.description: Devuelve únicamente claves públicas RSA para firma. La implementación usa RS256 y publica el identificador, módulo, exponente, uso y algoritmo de cada clave. Nunca devuelve material de firma privado. Las respuestas usan actualmente la directiva de caché no-store.

get.summary: Start or continue an authorization request
get.description: Use a top-level browser navigation. The raw query string is limited to 8192 bytes and 32 parameters. This endpoint accepts only response_type=code, response_mode=query, and code_challenge_method=S256. Bounded unknown query parameters are ignored; duplicate recognized parameters and explicitly unsupported OIDC parameters are rejected. A browser may already have the host-only Darkhorse session cookie; the confidential client must not copy or forward that cookie. The endpoint redirects the browser to login or consent when needed, or to the exact registered callback after completion. It does not support public clients, implicit/password grants, request objects, request_uri, claims, login_hint, or id_token_hint. Identity and resource access profiles are mutually exclusive. Supply unpredictable state and nonce values and validate state, issuer, and nonce at the callback.

es.summary: Iniciar o continuar una solicitud de autorización
es.description: Inicia este flujo mediante la navegación principal del navegador. La cadena de consulta sin procesar admite hasta 8192 bytes y 32 parámetros. El endpoint solo acepta response_type=code, response_mode=query y code_challenge_method=S256. Ignora parámetros de consulta desconocidos dentro del límite permitido; rechaza los parámetros reconocidos duplicados y los parámetros OIDC expresamente no admitidos. El navegador puede tener la cookie de sesión exclusiva del host de Darkhorse; el cliente confidencial no debe copiarla ni reenviarla. Cuando corresponde, el endpoint redirige el navegador al inicio de sesión o al consentimiento y, al completar el flujo, a la URL de callback registrada exacta. No admite clientes públicos, los grants implicit/password, request objects, request_uri, claims, login_hint ni id_token_hint. Los perfiles de identidad y de acceso a recursos son mutuamente excluyentes. Usa valores state y nonce impredecibles, y valida state, issuer y nonce al recibir el callback.

302.description: Redirect to the login/consent page or the validated client callback. Success and protocol errors return to the registered callback with issuer and applicable state parameters.

400.description: The authorization request is malformed, unsupported, or fails validation before a trusted callback can be selected.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code or rotate a refresh token
post.description: Call only from the confidential application's backend over verified HTTPS. Authenticate with one client_secret_basic HTTP Basic Authorization header, limited to 2048 bytes. The client identifier and secret use OAuth form encoding before Base64 encoding; never put either in the body, query, URL, browser storage, or logs. Form bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and 16 parameters; duplicate fields, query credentials, and parameters from the other grant are rejected. Bounded unrecognized form parameters are ignored for OAuth interoperability; recognized client-authentication parameters in the body are rejected. An authorization code is one-use, expires after 60 seconds, and must be redeemed with its original exact redirect_uri and PKCE verifier. If a response is lost, do not replay a one-use authorization code. For refresh rotation, reusing the previous refresh token is detected as replay and revokes its family; recover through a new authorization flow. Refresh rotation requires explicit client opt-in and remains bound to the original live browser session.

es.summary: Canjear un código de autorización o rotar un token de actualización
es.description: Llama a este endpoint solo desde el backend de la aplicación confidencial mediante HTTPS verificado. Autentica con un único encabezado Authorization HTTP Basic que usa client_secret_basic y admite hasta 2048 bytes. Codifica el identificador y el secreto del cliente como formulario OAuth antes de aplicar Base64; nunca incluyas ninguno en el cuerpo, la consulta, la URL, el almacenamiento del navegador ni los logs. El cuerpo de formulario admite hasta 4096 bytes y 16 parámetros; se rechazan campos duplicados, credenciales en la consulta y parámetros del otro grant. Se ignoran los parámetros de formulario desconocidos dentro del límite para mantener la interoperabilidad con OAuth; se rechazan en el cuerpo los parámetros de autenticación de cliente reconocidos. El código de autorización es de un solo uso, vence a los 60 segundos y debe canjearse con el redirect_uri exacto y el verificador PKCE originales. Si se pierde una respuesta, no vuelvas a enviar un código de autorización de un solo uso. En la rotación, reutilizar el token de actualización anterior se detecta como replay y revoca su familia; recupera el acceso mediante un nuevo flujo de autorización. La rotación requiere que el cliente la haya habilitado expresamente y sigue vinculada a la sesión de navegador original que permanece activa.

authorizationCode.summary: Code redeemed by a confidential backend

refresh.summary: Refresh request for a client that opted in

200.description: Opaque access credential and any enabled optional credentials. Identity requests can include a signed RS256 ID token; access and refresh credentials remain opaque.

get.summary: Read claims authorized by an identity access token
get.description: Send one opaque access token in the Authorization: Bearer header. This endpoint accepts only identity-profile access tokens with the UserInfo audience; it does not accept ID tokens, refresh tokens, authorization codes, logout tokens, or resource access tokens. The response reflects only the claim ceiling approved for that token and current profile values. Checks read current primary authority; after a committed revocation, session termination, deactivation, registration change, or consent reduction, new checks reject the token. An unavailable decision must fail closed.

es.summary: Consultar las claims autorizadas por un token de acceso de identidad
es.description: Envía un token de acceso opaco en el encabezado Authorization: Bearer. Este endpoint solo acepta tokens de acceso del perfil de identidad con la audiencia UserInfo; no acepta ID tokens, tokens de actualización, códigos de autorización, tokens de cierre de sesión ni tokens de acceso a recursos. La respuesta contiene únicamente las claims permitidas para ese token y los valores actuales del perfil. Las verificaciones consultan la autoridad primaria actual; después de confirmar una revocación, el cierre de una sesión, la desactivación, un cambio de registro o una reducción del consentimiento, las nuevas verificaciones rechazan el token. Si la decisión no está disponible, se debe denegar el acceso.

200.description: The subject and only the profile/email claims allowed by the issued identity scope ceiling.

post.summary: Check a credential with its authorized caller
post.description: Send one token in an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body over verified HTTPS. The HTTP Basic Authorization header is limited to 2048 bytes. A confidential issuing client authenticates with client_secret_basic and can inspect only its own issued credentials. A resource server authenticates with Basic username rs_<resource UUID> and its resource secret; this is required for resource access tokens and personal API keys. Inactive, expired, revoked, foreign, or wrong-purpose credentials return active=false after valid caller authentication. Authenticated checks consume shared admission budgets; 429 includes Retry-After. Resource servers must deny access when the decision is unavailable and must not fall back to cached positive decisions. Bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and 16 parameters; bounded unrecognized parameters are ignored and client-authentication parameters in the body are rejected. Token text is limited to 2048 bytes. Never send a credential in a URL or log it.

es.summary: Consultar una credencial con su cliente autorizado
es.description: Envía un token en el cuerpo application/x-www-form-urlencoded y usa HTTPS verificado. El encabezado Authorization HTTP Basic admite hasta 2048 bytes. Un cliente emisor confidencial se autentica con client_secret_basic y solo puede consultar las credenciales que él emitió. Un servidor de recursos se autentica con el nombre Basic rs_<UUID del recurso> y su secreto de recurso; esto es obligatorio para tokens de acceso a recursos y claves de API personales. Tras autenticar correctamente al cliente, las credenciales inactivas, vencidas, revocadas, ajenas o destinadas a otro uso devuelven active=false. Las consultas autenticadas consumen límites compartidos; la respuesta 429 incluye Retry-After. Los servidores de recursos deben denegar el acceso si la decisión no está disponible y no deben usar decisiones positivas almacenadas en caché como alternativa. El cuerpo admite hasta 4096 bytes y 16 parámetros; se ignoran los parámetros desconocidos dentro del límite y se rechazan los parámetros de autenticación de cliente en el cuerpo. El texto del token admite hasta 2048 bytes. Nunca envíes una credencial en una URL ni la incluyas en logs.

opaqueAccess.summary: Resource server checks a credential without exposing it in a URL

200.description: An authenticated answer. Inactive responses disclose only active=false.

post.summary: Revoke an issued access or refresh credential
post.description: Call from the confidential application's backend over verified HTTPS and authenticate with client_secret_basic. The HTTP Basic Authorization header is limited to 2048 bytes. The client can revoke only credentials from its own issuance context. Refresh-token revocation terminates its credential family and invalidates associated access credentials. A valid request returns 200 even if the credential is unknown, expired, already revoked, or belongs elsewhere. This endpoint does not revoke ID tokens or browser sessions. Bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and 16 parameters; bounded unrecognized parameters are ignored and client-authentication parameters in the body are rejected. Revocation is idempotent: if the response is lost, the same authenticated request can safely be repeated. Retry 503 responses with bounded backoff.

es.summary: Revocar un token de acceso o de actualización emitido
es.description: Llama desde el backend de la aplicación confidencial mediante HTTPS verificado y autentica con client_secret_basic. El encabezado Authorization HTTP Basic admite hasta 2048 bytes. El cliente solo puede revocar credenciales de su propio contexto de emisión. Revocar un token de actualización termina su familia de credenciales e invalida los tokens de acceso asociados. Una solicitud válida devuelve 200 aunque la credencial sea desconocida, esté vencida, ya revocada o pertenezca a otro cliente. Este endpoint no revoca ID tokens ni sesiones del navegador. El cuerpo admite hasta 4096 bytes y 16 parámetros; se ignoran los parámetros desconocidos dentro del límite y se rechazan los parámetros de autenticación de cliente en el cuerpo. La revocación es idempotente: si se pierde la respuesta, se puede repetir de forma segura la misma solicitud autenticada. Reintenta las respuestas 503 con retroceso acotado.

200.description: The request was accepted; the response body is empty.

ClientSecretBasic.description: OIDC confidential-client authentication. Encode the client ID and secret using application/x-www-form-urlencoded component rules, join with a colon, then Base64 encode for HTTP Basic. TLS is mandatory. Use only the server-side secret store; never expose the secret in a browser or URL.

ResourceServerBasic.description: Resource-server authentication for introspection only. The Basic username is rs_<resource UUID>; the password is that registered resource's secret. This credential is distinct from a user's personal API key and from an OIDC client secret. TLS is mandatory.

OpaqueAccessBearer.description: An opaque, short-lived identity access token returned by /token. It is not an ID token or refresh token and is not a JWT. Send it only in the Authorization header to the UserInfo endpoint.

ClientId.name: client_id
ClientId.description: Canonical lowercase UUID of the confidential client, not the owning application ID.

RedirectUri.name: redirect_uri
RedirectUri.description: Exact HTTPS callback string registered for this client, including path and any query encoding. Matching does not normalize or resolve the URI.

ResponseMode.name: response_mode
ResponseMode.description: Only query is supported; omission uses the query response mode.

Scope.name: scope
Scope.description: Space-separated scopes. Include openid. Identity requests may additionally request profile/email; resource requests use an explicitly registered resource and allowed resource scopes and cannot mix identity-only scopes beyond openid.

CodeChallenge.name: code_challenge
CodeChallenge.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of the SHA-256 hash of the high-entropy code_verifier.

State.name: state
State.description: Optional printable ASCII value returned unchanged at the callback. Clients should always generate and validate an unpredictable value bound to the browser flow.

Nonce.name: nonce
Nonce.description: Optional printable ASCII value copied into the ID token when supplied. Clients should generate a fresh unpredictable nonce and validate it in the ID token.

Resource.name: resource
Resource.description: Optional exact registered resource audience identifier. Required for resource access. It is not a URL to fetch.

Prompt.name: prompt
Prompt.description: Optional interaction control. none never displays an interaction and returns login_required or consent_required when silent completion is impossible.

MaxAge.name: max_age
MaxAge.description: Maximum authentication age in seconds, from 0 to 28800. Zero requires a new sign-in after this authorization request begins.

UiLocales.name: ui_locales
UiLocales.description: Space-separated language tags. The server supports English and Spanish and falls back for unsupported preferences; this changes presentation, not claims or authority.

NoStore.description: Responses containing credentials are not stored by caches.

NoCache.description: Legacy cache directive accompanying no-store on credential responses.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying a rate-limited introspection request.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed, unsupported, or incorrectly bound request.

InvalidClient.description: Client or resource-server authentication failed. The response does not identify which credential field was incorrect.

InvalidBearer.description: Missing, malformed, inactive, expired, revoked, or stale bearer credential.

RateLimited.description: Admission limit reached. Honor Retry-After. Do not substitute a previous positive authorization decision.

TemporarilyUnavailable.description: A dependency or current authority decision is unavailable. Protected operations must fail closed.

AuthorizationCodeGrant.description: Unknown bounded OAuth extension parameters are ignored. Client-authentication parameters in the form body and refresh_token from the other grant are rejected; authenticate with client_secret_basic.

RefreshTokenGrant.description: Unknown bounded OAuth extension parameters are ignored. Client-authentication parameters in the form body and code, redirect_uri, or code_verifier from the other grant are rejected; authenticate with client_secret_basic.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single-use rotating refresh credential; it is not a JWT.

scope.description: Optional requested narrowing. It cannot expand the previous credential's approved scope ceiling.

access_token.description: Opaque access credential. Store and transmit only as a bearer credential over TLS.

refresh_token.description: Present only when the client opted in and the grant issued a refresh credential.

id_token.description: Signed RS256 JWT for identity; validate its signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce when used, auth_time, and session reference. It is not an API access token.

IntrospectionRequest.description: Unknown bounded OAuth extension parameters are ignored. Client-authentication parameters in the form body are rejected; authenticate with the documented HTTP Basic credential.

token_type_hint.description: Optional hint accepted for compatibility and ignored when identifying the supplied credential. It has no independent length bound beyond the endpoint's form-body limit.

RevocationRequest.description: Unknown bounded OAuth extension parameters are ignored. Client-authentication parameters in the form body are rejected; authenticate with client_secret_basic.

token_type_hint.description: Optional hint accepted for compatibility and ignored when identifying the supplied credential. It has no independent length bound beyond the endpoint's form-body limit.
